title: If the Sky Had a Floor

scenes.text: What if the atmosphere had a floor, a hard lid you could stand on?
scenes.art_prompt: a person climbing toward a solid layer of clouds, 3d render

scenes.text: You would climb until your weight faded, then walk across the sky like a ceiling.
scenes.art_prompt: walking upside down on a ceiling of cloud, 3d render

scenes.text: Storms would pool beneath you. The ocean would look like a map you could fold.
scenes.art_prompt: storms pooling beneath a glassy sky, 3d render

scenes.text: But air already has a floor. It is called pressure, and it holds you against the world.
scenes.art_prompt: the curve of the ocean seen from high above, 3d render

scenes.text:
You are standing on the sky right now.
You just call it the ground.
scenes.art_prompt: a vast calm sky with one horizon line, wonder, 3d render

scenes.text: Follow What If Physics for the next question.
scenes.art_prompt: a wide sky at dusk, calm and final, 3d render
